results.known_reason: gocomposer has no self-update mechanism (it is not a composer.phar): like Composer run from a source checkout it prints "This instance of Composer does not have the self-update command." and exits 1, but the explanatory second line names gocomposer instead of Composer's system-package/project-package reasons
differences:
stdout:
+ (go) gocomposer does not implement self-update as it is not distributed as a composer.phar. Rebuild or reinstall gocomposer to update it.
- (oracle) This could be due to a number of reasons, such as Composer being installed as a system package on your OS, or Composer being installed as a package in the current project.
